description: This file implements a TCP socket server class 'SocketServer' with methods for opening a socket, accepting connections, sending and receiving messages, and handling responses. It also defines related data structures and enums for socket communication, including command IDs and message headers.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a response message with a channel ID and JSON payload.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: Implements a TCP socket server for handling client connections, message exchange, and server control.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initializes and starts the server socket, binds to an address and port, and begins listening for connections.

methods.name: RunThread
methods.description: Creates a thread to run the server's main loop.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main server loop that accepts client connections and processes incoming messages.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the server and client sockets, stopping the server.

methods.name: ReadExact
methods.description: Reads an exact number of bytes from the client socket.

methods.name: SendInvoke
methods.description: Sends an invoke command with a channel ID, token, and JSON payload to the client.

methods.name: SendAttach
methods.description: Sends an attach command with a channel ID and attach flag.

methods.name: SendExit
methods.description: Sends an exit command to terminate the client connection.

methods.name: ReadResponse
methods.description: Reads a response message from the client, including channel ID and JSON payload.
